newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 12 as grain charterers boost Panamaxes.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 12 as grain charterers boost Panamaxes.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index rose 12 points on Wednesday to 1,387 with brokers saying that booming demand for Panamaxes fuelled by grain charterers has been the principal feature of today's freight market.

Modern Panamaxes in the Atlantic are now commanding well in excess of $15,000 daily delivery Continent for trips via USGulf to the Far East, and in the Pacific similar tonnage is now fixing at around $12,000 daily for Pacific or Australian rounds.
A high volume of new grain enquiry has contributed to optimistic sentiment for owners but Caper and Handy-size rates remained flat, brokers said.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was 20 to 49 points higher reflecting the renewed optimism in the underlying market. Turnover totalled 188 lots.
